ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Navinchandra Vershibhai Haria has acquired 7.19% equity in Aakash Exploration Services Limited from fellow promoter Pravin Vershibhai Haria through an inter-se transfer without monetary consideration (gift). This transaction, exempt under SEBI regulations, is an internal restructuring of promoter shareholding and results in no change to the overall promoter group's control or total ownership of the company. The transfer maintains the existing promoter control structure, with the individual ownership shifting within the group.
